dict.string: MogMe photographs meals so you can save them locally and look up calories by the package name or label text.
MogMe can use a library photo of a meal or a chat screenshot for Diet and Wingman.
MogMe only writes meal photos into its own sandbox unless you export them.
MogMe uses GPS while Japanese walking and interval cardio are running so distance and the route stay accurate.
MogMe can keep GPS running if you lock the phone mid-workout so the walk or cardio session does not drop.
MogMe can use motion to stabilize workout pace when GPS is noisy.
Siri can log foods, start Japanese walking or interval cardio, and hand a prompt to Wingman.
Optional voice for Siri shortcuts only.
